text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Ruka, on a day off from work, is taking a stroll around
Landosol's outskirts when she bumps
into {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魚屋の仕事が休みの日に、ランドソルの郊外を散歩していたルカは、
{0}と出会った。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there.
You're looking pretty busy. Work, I take it?
choice_data_list: I'm helping out with the road construction here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっ、
お前さん。
お疲れみたいだね。
仕事かい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Now that's some hard labor.
Would explain why you're covered in dirt.
How about I treat you to a meal? I bet you're starving.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ソイツはまた重労働だね……
通りで土まみれなわけだ。
腹減ってるだろ。
飯でも奢ろうか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Also, wow. The sun sure is bright today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても……
やけに太陽が眩しいね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hey. Is it really the sun that's making things so bright...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ、
あれ、
ホントに太陽……
か……？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Aaahhh! Someone help! There's a thief on the loose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあああっ！　
誰かぁ！　
泥棒よー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: A thief? Which way did they go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒？　
おばちゃん、
どっちに逃げたんだ？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Ruka! The fish you just sold me got stolen!
text_block_list.orig_text:
流夏ちゃん！　
さっき売ってもらった魚が盗られちゃったのよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
A feline felon, huh? Now that's trouble.
I'll go after it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒猫か。
そいつは一大事だね。
アタシが追いかけるよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You will?
Oh, I recognize that face. You're one of our regulars.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんが？
どっかで見た顔だと思ったら、
ウチのお得意さんじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I'm Ruka Tachiarai.
Let's get that fish back!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは太刀洗流夏。
お前さんとアタシで、
魚を取り返すよ！

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If it's running this way, it's going to try and escape along the fence.
You follow it up there! I'll circle around and catch it off guard!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちに逃げるってことは、
塀を伝って行く気だね。
お前さんは塀の上から追いかけてくれ！　
アタシは先回りしておく！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Flanking it's our best bet here! I'm counting on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人で挟み撃ちだ！　
頼んだよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Now, where's it most likely to go?
Over there, I'd say. I better hurry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この辺りで猫が行きそうな場所といえば……
あっちか。
ちょっと急がなきゃね。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Eeek! A peeping Tom!
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃーっ！　覗きよーっ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: There's a pervert up on that fence!
text_block_list.orig_text: 塀の上に変質者が！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! You a thief or something?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ！　
なんだお前、
泥棒か！？

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Oh, there it is! Gotcha!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おっ、
きたきた！　
そりゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
...Or not. Oh well.
I know where that cat's turf is, so it's just a matter of
working together with him to corner it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……逃げられたか。
まあいいさ。
アイツらの縄張りは全部把握してるし、
あの子と上手く追い詰めていけばいい。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
There you are. Thanks for the help.
I'm afraid I let it get away, though.
But it shot off that way, so let's follow suit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、お前さん。
ご苦労様。
アイツはちょうど逃がしちまってね。
あっちに行ったから追いかけよう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. Did something happen?
Things seemed pretty hectic over where you came from.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもお前さんが来た方向が、
妙に騒がしかったね。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Stop right there, you pervert!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ちなさいよ変質者ーっ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Pervo! Weirdo! You're a danger to all women!
text_block_list.orig_text:
痴漢！　
変態！　
女の敵！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh. Didn't expect this turn of events.
Sorry, this is all my fault.
We should probably get this cleared up first, shouldn't we?
choice_data_list: We've got more important things to deal with.
Getting that fish back takes priority.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あちゃあ。
変質者扱いか。
すまないね、
アタシが言ったばっかりに。
追いかけるより先に、
誤解を解いたほうがいいんじゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I appreciate it.
I swear I'll get this sorted out for you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
助かるよ、
ありがとう。
誤解は必ずなんとかしてやるよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
True enough.
I'll back you up later, then. Trust me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かにそうだね。
後でアタシも一緒に説明するよ。
まかせときな！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I have a good idea of where it went.
Let's make our way over to the riverbank!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツの逃げた先は見当がついてる。
土手に向かうよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Now then. It should be around here somewhere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
いるとしたらこの辺りのはずだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there we go.
The gig's up, my little feline felon.
You sure had us on a wild chase...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
いたいた。
見つけたよ、泥棒猫。
ったく、
手間かけさせやがって……

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
So that's what's going on.
You stole it for them, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうか。
アンタ、
この子たちのために……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. You could've said something, you know?
Just kidding. Only a crazy person would expect a cat to explain itself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ……
事情があるならそう言いやがれっての。
なんて、
猫だから無理なんだけどね。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: You won't get away!
text_block_list.orig_text: もう逃げられないわよ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Quit running!
text_block_list.orig_text: 大人しくしなさい！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: It's not too late to set things right! Just turn yourself in!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今ならまだ間に合う！　
自首するんだ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
The cast is all assembled.
Let's get your name cleared, shall we?
Then we can go search for the owner of these cats.
text_block_list.orig_text:
役者も揃ったね。
それじゃあお前さんへの誤解を解こうか。
あとは、
この猫たちの飼い主も探してやらなきゃな。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Folks! There's something you need to know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
追っかけてきた人たち！　
聞いて欲しいことがあるんだ！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Huh? Aren't you the Tachiarais' daughter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
キミ、
太刀洗さんとこの……

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: She's from the fishmonger's place in the shopping district!
text_block_list.orig_text: 商店街の魚屋さん！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なになに、
どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
This guy isn't a thief, or anything of the sort!
He was helping me catch a cat!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この子が泥棒ってのは誤解だ！　
アタシと一緒に猫を捕まえるのを、
手伝ってくれてたんだ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
And as you can see, we did it.
So please, don't hold it against him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご覧の通り猫は見つかった。
さっきまでのことは、
水に流してやっておくれよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Well... If she says it, it has to be true.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの魚屋さんが言うんだし、
間違いないか。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: So he wasn't a pervert? Thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
変質者じゃなかったんだ……
良かった。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
And with that, your name's all cleared.
Now we just need to deal with these cats...
Except I'm not really sure how to go about this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでお前さんの誤解は解けたね。
あとはこの猫たちか……
やれやれ、どうしたもんか……

text_block_list.name: Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Boss Lady?
Wassup! Didn't expect to bump into you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
姉御？　
チィーッス！　
流夏の姉御！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. Also, quit calling me that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタか……
っておい、
姉御って呼ぶんじゃないよ。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I'm just too used to it. Hehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すいません、
つい……
へへへっ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Curious about him, are we? He was getting up to
no good a while back, so I gave him a good scolding.
Now he's pretty much all over me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、コイツかい？　
前に悪さしてるところを叱ってやったら、
すっかり懐かれちまってね。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent
text_block_list.text: You in a bind, Boss Lady?
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御、
なんか困ってんすか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
How many times do I need to tell you... Whatever.
More importantly, could you try and search for the owner of these cats?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから姉御は……
いやまぁいいや。
それより、
この猫たちの飼い主を探してくれないか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You know my family runs a fishmonger's shop.
And cats love fish, so I can't exactly take them in.
That's why I want you to do it, just until you find their owner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウチは魚屋だろ？
売り物に手を出されても困るから、
猫は飼えなくてね。
飼い主が見つかるまで、
預かってくれるだけでもいいんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent
text_block_list.text: Anything for you, Boss Lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御の頼みなら、
いくらでも手伝うっすよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You're doing that on purpose, aren't you?
Anyway, the best case scenario would be for someone to take them all in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタ分かっててそう呼んでるね……
まあいいや。
まとめて飼ってくれる人がいると、
一番いいんだけどね。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask my buds if any of them can manage it!
And I'll have them ask their buds as well, so no need to worry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとダチに飼えそうなヤツいないか聞いてみます！
ソイツらの知り合いにもあたってもらいますから、
心配しないでください！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Knowing him, he'll get the job done quick.
Which means we're pretty much done here. Thanks for all the help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとね。
……ま、アイツらならすぐに見つけてくれるだろ。
とりあえず一件落着だな。
お前さんもお疲れ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I have to admit, you really took me by surprise.
Helping me out is one thing, but you didn't even flinch
when people started calling you all sorts of names.
choice_data_list: I just wanted to help someone in need.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても大したヤツだね、
お前さんは。
いきなりだってのにアタシを手伝ってくれたし、
誤解されても気にもしない。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Now that's not a line you hear often nowadays.
You really are a man's man, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ……
今時珍しいね。
そこまで人のために動けるなんて。
お前さん、
ホントに大した男だよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You should pop by our store next time
you're in the shopping district. I'll give you a super
special discount. And thanks again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度商店街に来たらウチの店に顔出しておくれよ。
とっておきのを安くしてあげるからさ。
……今日はありがとね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And that's that. Welcome back.
Did you enjoy that little dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れさま。 
どうだったかしら、
アタシの夢。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Ruka really is kind and caring, isn't she?
And she's even strong to boot.
It's no wonder so many people look up to her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカって本当に気っ風が良くて、面倒見のいい人よね。
腕っ節も強いし。
色んな人に慕われるのも納得だわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I just wish she wouldn't take it so far sometimes.
I had a pretty terrible experience thanks to that in the past.
Though I guess it's a fond memory at this point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ただ時々やりすぎちゃうところは何とかして欲しいわ……
あたしも昔ひどい目にあったのよ。
……今となっては懐かしい話だけど。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget, though. She's no superhero. There'll come a time
when she faces something she can't overcome on her own.
It's your job to support her when that time comes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
彼女も一人の人間よ。
いつか一人じゃ乗り切れないことがきっとあるわ。
そういう時はアンタがそばで支えてあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll see you around!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Hm?
Guess I dozed off at some point.
*yawn*
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
ん？　
どうやら寝ちまってたみたいだね……
ふわぁ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Good morning. Guess we both fell asleep, huh?
I even had a pretty vivid dream.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんも寝てたのか？　
アタシもだよ。
まさか夢まで見ちまうとはね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You dreamed about chasing after a cat, huh?
Same as me, then.There was even a boy in it
just like you, determined to help others out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか、
猫を探す夢を……
アタシと同じだね。
ちょうどお前さんみたく、
人のために動いてた子が出てきたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
That was just a dream, but I know for a fact
that you'd do the same even in real life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さんなら、
きっと夢なんかじゃなくても
同じことをしてくれるって信じてるよ。

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: THIEF! Someone catch them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒ーっ！　
そいつを捕まえてくれーっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
A thief, is it? I'd ask what we should do,
but that'd be a waste of time, wouldn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
泥棒だって？
　
どうする……
って聞くまでもないか。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going!
We'll catch that thief in no time if we work together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行くよお前さん！　
いっちょ二人で、
泥棒をとっちめてやろう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus the two of them sprung into action,
ready to deliver justice together once more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカと{0}は、泥棒を捕まえるため、
共に街を駆け抜けていった。
